title: ManaCube
description: ManaCube is a flourishing Minecraft community renowned for its wide variety of engaging Minecraft servers
body:
ManaCube is a flourishing minecraft community renowned for its wide variety of engaging Minecraft servers. Our gamemodes have been played by 7 million people over the last 12 years!

**Parkour**
Complete over 25000 unique parkour maps and adventure maps

**Olympus**
Greek mythology RPG, where you can grow as demi-gods through unique quests, mining, battles and exploration

**Skyblock**
Build your world on a secluded island. Explore other rpg worlds for upgrades and items.

**Survival**
A super enhanced Minecraft survival experience

**Factions**
Base building/defending game where you use custom Raid & Defender mobs.

**Earth Towny
**Geopolitical sandbox experience, allowing players to create and rule their own towns or nations.

**KitPvP**
A classic 1.8 PVP server protected by our custom Manaray anticheat.
